blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A lone bettor won the ₱115.99 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draw on Friday, Oct. 16, 2026. The winning combination was 08-22-19-10-35-27, with one ticket holder matching all six numbers to claim the jackpot. Meanwhile, no bettor won the ₱401.34 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot.
